title: Tracy's migration chain moves the WO tables from account to wo_principal (171 + 172) with no manual step, keeps every row and does not deadlock a live ledger writer
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at a scratch Postgres, run the regression script; it runs apps/tracy-web/test/wo-schema-baseline.test.mjs.
S2: Read the 171/172 data test: chain through 169-site-push.sql, WO rows written, full chain applied, rollback block run, chain re-applied.
S3: Read the deadlock test: a transaction holds wo_cost_ledger, the chain queues behind it, the same transaction then inserts a ledger row with a payer account and commits.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped; the script prints PASS.
S2: full chain applies 171-wo-principal.sql and 172-wo-principal-validate.sql, rows are unchanged, all seven FKs point at wo_principal and are validated, verifyWoSchema returns no difference.
S3: no deadlock (40P01): the writer commits and the migration completes.
evidence: The hand-applied 169-wo-principal.sql deadlocked a ledger insert on every measured run and missed accounts created during its backfill
fence: Migrations 171/172 and the migrator; does not drive a stand or a browser
